name: Hammock Beach Golf Resort & Spa
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on 300 pristine acres where two Jack Nicklaus signature golf courses meet the Atlantic coastline, creating Florida's most spectacular golf and spa retreat.
whats_special: Home to the only seaside golf course in Florida designed by Jack Nicklaus, featuring the famous Ocean Course where several holes play directly along the dunes. The resort's massive 91,000-square-foot water complex includes a 240-foot lazy river that winds through tropical landscaping, making it one of the largest resort pool areas on the East Coast.
pro_tip: Book tee times on the Ocean Course for late afternoon - you'll catch golden hour lighting over the Atlantic while playing some of the most photographed holes in American golf.
dont_miss: The signature 6th hole on the Ocean Course, where you'll tee off from elevated dunes with panoramic ocean views, and the adults-only infinity pool that seems to spill directly into the Atlantic horizon at sunset.
pros: Two championship golf courses designed by Jack Nicklaus and Tom Watson
Direct oceanfront location with private beach access
Full-service spa and multiple dining venues
Family-friendly amenities including water slides and kids' activities
cons: Resort fees and additional charges for amenities
Can be crowded during peak golf season
